title: Dancing Moose Farm

services.name: Yurt Rentals
services.desc: We have a 24’ hospitality yurt to host festive gatherings, educational classes, or group dinners and three 20’ yurts for overnight farm stays. The site is available for individual or group rentals. The purpose of Dancing Moose Farm is for our visitors to gain knowledge about permaculture farming and enjoy a farm stay experience. We have bathrooms with hot water and flushing toilets. No pit toilets here! To ensure a pleasant experience for all, we ask everyone to be respectful of our animals, neighbors, and fellow guests. Our farm is meant to be explored so understanding a few basic ground rules helps reduce danger and protect our working farm. These rules are discussed in the farm
